title: ActionScript 2 AST parser
description: Build an AS2 recursive-descent parser on top of the tokenizer (0041) in packages/core/src/as2/parser.ts. AST node types: Program, FunctionDecl, ClassDecl, VarDecl, IfStmt, ForStmt, WhileStmt, ReturnStmt, ExprStmt, AssignExpr, BinaryExpr, UnaryExpr, CallExpr, MemberExpr, NewExpr, Literal, Identifier. parse(source: string): Program. Export from packages/core/src/as2/index.ts. No UI. See docs/12-actionscript.md.
